:::{#thm-moments-low-order}
#### The second central moment is the variance

If $\E{X^2} < \infty$,
then the second [central moment](#def-central-moment) of $X$ is $\Var{X}$.

:::

::: proof

The second [central moment](#def-central-moment) is $\E{[\devn(X)]^2}$ by @def-central-moment,
which is $\Var{X}$ by @def-variance.

:::
